major_cooldowns.name: Adrenaline Rush
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown, ideally at low combo points if running Improved Adrenaline Rush.

major_cooldowns.name: Blade Rush
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown as long as it won't cap your energy.

major_cooldowns.name: Keep It Rolling
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use when you have at least 3 Roll the Bones buffs active to extend them.

major_cooldowns.name: Between the Eyes
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown at 6+ combo points for damage and the crit buff.

major_cooldowns.name: Preparation
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use to reset Adrenaline Rush and Between the Eyes when both are on cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Killing Spree
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use at 5+ combo points; cancel early if you are going to overcap energy.

defensives.name: Cloak of Shadows
defensives.usage_rule: Use to immune magic damage and clear debuffs.

defensives.name: Feint
defensives.usage_rule: Use preemptively to reduce incoming AoE damage.

rules.description: Don't Preparation while Adrenaline Rush is up
rules.action: Hold Preparation until Adrenaline Rush fades, otherwise you waste the reset.
Use Dispatch or Between the Eyes at 6+ combo points before overcapping.

rules.description: Hold Keep It Rolling for strong RtB buffs
rules.action: Only cast Keep It Rolling when you have at least 3 Roll the Bones buffs active (or 2 if rerolling is unsafe).

rules.description: Cancel Killing Spree to avoid energy cap
rules.action: Interrupt Killing Spree with a builder or finisher if your energy is about to cap.

source_summary: Outlaw Rogue relies on high APM and zero-downtime resource generation. The rotation prioritizes maintaining Adrenaline Rush and Between the Eyes, using Keep It Rolling to lock in strong Roll the Bones buffs, and avoiding combo point or energy overcaps.
